channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Man, 81, Found Dead After Fire Rips Through NY Apartment Building
item.description: An 81-year-old man died in a fire at his Brooklyn apartment.

item.title: Massive Fire Destroys Multiple Buildings in Historic MO Downtown
item.description: A significant fire in downtown Cameron, MO, destroyed multiple buildings housing businesses and apartments.

item.title: Trapped Tesla Driver’s 911 Call: ‘It’s on Fire. Help Please’
item.description: A lawsuit alleges that Tesla's electric door systems can trap occupants during crashes, leading to fatalities.

item.title: Veteran Firefighter Who Drowned at NJ Marina Is Identified
item.description: Firefighter Howard Bennett of the Camden Fire Department died after falling through ice at Wiggins Park Marina while working on a fire boat.

item.title: Four Killed in Atlanta House Fire; Two Children Rescued
item.description: A late-night fire in southeast Atlanta killed four people, including a man and three elderly victims. Two children were rescued by family members before firefighters arrived.

item.title: The Single Source for Fire Service Training Guidance: The New NFPA 1400
item.description: What does the new NFPA 1400, Standard on Fire Service Training, mean for firefighters and instructors? Dan Shaw takes a look at the consolidated standard and its implications.

item.title: Rescue Under Fire and Ice: NJ Firefighters Save Bedridden Resident from Residential Fire
item.description: Firefighters in Maplewood, NJ, rescued a trapped resident from a basement fire, highlighting the need for rapid response and effective communication in emergency situations.

item.title: The Training Officer: Apparatus Positioning and Traffic Insights
item.description: In this episode of The Training Officer, host Dave McGlynn welcomes Battalion Chief Bobby Drake of Hanover County (VA) Fire-EMS. They discuss the critical but often overlooked topic of fire apparatus positioning at motor vehicle accidents and roadway incidents. Drawing from personal experience and department practices, Drake stresses why preplanning and understanding local traffic patterns can […]

item.title: Three Fatalities, Three Injuries in OH Fire
item.description: A structure fire in Austinburg resulted in three fatalities and three injuries. The cause is under investigation, with multiple fire departments assisting at the scene.

item.title: Video Shows CT Firefighters Battle Fire That Displaced Four Residents
item.description: Firefighters in Norwalk extinguished a garage fire on Eastwood Road in about 15 minutes. No injuries were reported, but four residents were displaced as the cause is under investigation.
